tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders should submit all the technical document as per document attached
Tenderer should quote rate GST and all other taxes

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs 6.38 Lakhs, Turnover certificate to be furnished along with necessary documents
Bidders should submit all the technical document as perdocument attached
Supply of food to any government organization for at least for Rupees Rs 3.26 lakhs tender amount. Copy of work order or satisfactory work done letter should be submitted
The firm should have their head office/branch office within a radius of 40 Kms from TMC Bannur.Proof should be submitted
